description: This file defines a React hook named useProjectCost that fetches and formats the aggregated cost of a project from a backend API. It manages state for data, loading, and error, and provides a method to refetch the data. It also formats the cost using Intl.NumberFormat for display purposes.

methods.name: useProjectCost
methods.description: React hook that fetches and formats project cost data from backend API, managing loading and error states, and providing a refetch method.
